speaker: Chelsea Clinton
text: Remember these women.

speaker: Chelsea Clinton
text: They persisted and so should you.

speaker: Father
text: Back again. Good. The tide's kind this afternoon.

speaker: Father
text: Well, hello there. We don't get many visitors out past the mangroves.

speaker: Father
text: I'm a fisherman, mostly. Or something close to it. The boat does the real work.

speaker: Father
text: You can try the stones if you like. Flat ones skip best.

speaker: Father
text: Low and sideways, from the wrist. Don't throw it, let it go.

speaker: Father
text: There. Three skips. Don't tell anyone I counted.

speaker: Father
text: Her mother, actually. She could get seven out of a flat stone, and she never once let me forget it.

speaker: Father
text: It's all right. It's a good thing to remember.

speaker: Father
text: My daughter has her wrist.

speaker: Father
text: That's allowed. The beach isn't going anywhere.

speaker: Father
text: There's lemonade up at the house when you want it. Key lime, from our own tree.

speaker: Daughter
text: Come on! They haven't had their brushing yet.

speaker: Daughter
text: Hi! I've got two hundred stones in this bucket and I'm only allowed to keep fifty.

speaker: Daughter
text: Dad says I'm a collector, not a hoarder. I think that's just a nicer word.

speaker: Daughter
text: The grey ones with a white stripe all the way around. Those are lucky.

speaker: Daughter
text: You can have one. I've got four more.

speaker: Daughter
text: Dolphins, if you wait. Crabs, always. A pelican who thinks he owns the dock.

speaker: Daughter
text: And the horses, out back of the house. Do you like horses?

speaker: Daughter
text: Then you have to come see them! Wait. Hat.

speaker: Daughter
text: Okay, got my hat. And my brush. Let's go!

speaker: Daughter
text: Oh, that's the best! They'll just stand there and let you be new.

speaker: Daughter
text: Wait, hat. Okay. This way!

speaker: Daughter
text: Okay! I'll be here. They'll be there. Nobody's in a hurry.

speaker: Daughter
text: You're back! They remember you. Look at the ears, that means hello.

speaker: Daughter
text: You came! Okay. Hat's on, brush is ready. These are the horses!

speaker: Daughter
text: Oh, hi! You found the horses. Well, ponies. They're horses in their hearts.

speaker: Daughter
text: That's {{Cast.short("pony_butterscotch")}}, that's {{Cast.short("pony_waffles")}}, and that one's {{Cast.short("pony_daisy")}}. Say hi, everybody.

speaker: Daughter
text: What do you want to do?

speaker: Daughter
text: Click one and pick the brush. Long strokes, the way the hair goes. Don't push, just let it glide.

speaker: Daughter
text: You can do their manes however you like. Braids, curls, a bow, a flower. They don't mind.

speaker: Daughter
text: They just like the attention. Same as everybody.

speaker: Daughter
text: Sure! Pick a grown-up one and hop on. They go way faster than walking.

speaker: Daughter
text: Hop down whenever you want. They know the way home, even from the beach.

speaker: Daughter
text: Two ponies, and then a foal! Dad says every foal gets a little bit from each of them.

speaker: Daughter
text: Like how I've got Mom's wrist for skipping stones. And Dad's hat-forgetting.

speaker: Daughter
text: Mostly! But sometimes a foal comes out a color neither of them is.

speaker: Daughter
text: Dad says it was hiding in there the whole time, waiting its turn. Isn't that the best?

speaker: Daughter
text: Nope! That's the fun part. You just wait and see who shows up.

speaker: Daughter
text: Every one of them is exactly right.

speaker: Daughter
text: That's allowed. Nobody's in a hurry out here.

speaker: Daughter
text: {{Cast.short("pony_waffles")}} likes being watched. She does a little hop when she thinks you're looking.

speaker: Gloria
text: The Priestess smiled at the offering. I am... relieved.

speaker: Gloria
text: You really didn't take it. And nothing terrible happened.

speaker: Gloria
text: Yet. Probably. I mean— have a lovely cycle!

speaker: Gloria
text: The offering! Priestess Betty is waiting in the Temple.

speaker: Gloria
text: Oh! You're the new arrival. The Festival of the Fourteenth is coming.

speaker: Gloria
text: Would you carry this offering to Priestess Betty? Everyone contributes.

speaker: Gloria
text: Everyone.

speaker: Gloria
text: You're a good one. They notice that, you know.

speaker: Gloria
text: Because... because that's how it's always been?

speaker: Gloria
text: Huh. No one's ever actually asked me that before.

speaker: Gloria
text: Take it anyway — but that was a good question.

speaker: Gloria
text: You can... say that? Just like that?

speaker: Gloria
text: "No, thank you." Hm. It didn't even thunder.

speaker: Priestess Betty
text: The Seal of the O shines upon the obedient, dear.

speaker: Priestess Betty
text: Ah. {{Cast.short("initiate")}}'s little offering. Set it by the icons.

speaker: Priestess Betty
text: See how easy? The Covenant loves an easy girl.

speaker: Priestess Betty
text: ...That was a compliment, dear.

speaker: Priestess Betty
text: Questions. How... modern of you.

speaker: Priestess Betty
text: Set it down anyway, there's a love.

speaker: Priestess Betty
text: I heard you told Gloria "no thank you."

speaker: Priestess Betty
text: What a fascinating phrase. We'll be watching your cycle with interest.

speaker: Priestess Betty
text: Welcome, initiate. The Queen Mothers see all who wish to be seen.

speaker: Priestess Betty
text: And all who don't, of course. That's rather the point of Them.
